title: Lista de materiais e carga por painel
purpose: Gerar a LI/BOM e a carga de cada PN com quantitativos matematicamente rastreáveis, incluindo toda a montagem e fiação interna.
material_scope: fios internos por tipo secao cor e metragem calculada
PE equipotencializacao e tranças de porta
cabos internos de rede/bus e conectores
terminais ilhoses terminais olhal garfo e marcadores
prensa cabos tampoes passagens e sistemas de entrada
fixadores parafusos porcas arruelas espacadores suportes
todos os kits e pecas exigidos pela cadeia de montagem do fabricante

quantity_engine.authority: connection graph + real-scale layout geometry + manufacturer accessory requirements
quantity_engine.internal_wire_formula: route + origin termination + destination termination + service loop; procurement allowance only if explicit project parameter
quantity_engine.volume_area_checks: Wolfram plus deterministic geometry; never volume-only for collision or clearance
quantity_engine.duct_fill: use conductor bundle cross-sectional area and applicable manufacturer/normative fill criteria
quantity_engine.terminals: derive from connection topology and terminal plan
quantity_engine.ferrules_lugs_markers: derive from actual conductor endpoints and termination technology

source_learning_rule: Standards/academic evidence from Step 3 plus manufacturer assembly manuals, official training and assembly videos may support methods. Videos are secondary and never authority for ratings or normative requirements.
